How to read the regime
● Bull + BTC Dominance falling → Alt season. Full scan, loosen RVOL threshold.
● Neutral → Normal scan. Apply all gates. BUY only score ≥ 70.
● Bear → No new alts. Only BTC / ETH setups, defensive sizing.
● Extreme Fear (<25) → Capitulation zone. Look for reversal setups.
● Extreme Greed (>75) → Reduce size. Fade breakouts.
